main_text.p: עַתִּיקָא, עַתִּיק Ch. & Syr. Vetus, inveteratum. Plural.
עַתִּיקָא, עַתִּיקִין. Fœmin. עַתִּיקָתָא. Plur. Syr. ܥܬܝܩܐ Vetera.
ܥܬܝܩܘܬܐ Syr. Antiquitas, vetustas, ad Rom.7.6. Sic in Targ. Jon. legitur סִגְרוּתָא עַתִּיקוּתָא Lepra inveterata, Levit.13.11. quamvis hîc rectiùs forte leges עַתִּיקְתָּא adjectivè.
עַתְקָא Ch. Angustia, Psal.22.11. pro עַקְתָּא.
עָתַר Ch. & Syr. Ditescere, ditari, locupletari. Ithpah. אִתְעַתַּר Idem. Pahel עַתַּר Ditare, locupletare. Aphel אַעְתַּר Idem. Derivatum ab Hebraeo עָשַׁר ש & ת permutatis.
עֲתִירָא, עַתִּיר Ch. & Syr. Dives. Plur. עֲתִירִי, עֲתִירִין. Plur.fœm. Mulieres divites, Act.13.50.
עָתְרָא, עוּתְרָא Ch. & Syr. Divitiæ, opes, facultates.
פְּאָה, פַּתָא, פְּאָתָא Ch. Angulus, extremitas, latus, plaga, ut Hebraicè.
פְּנַר Syr. Fraenum. Plur. Fraena, Jacob.3.3.
פְּגַן Ch. Aries, Tormentum vel machina bellica ad muros & turres concutiendos. Plur. cum affix. פְּגוֹחֵי Tormenta sua, Ezech.26.9.
פְּגוּל Chald. Foetor, Abominatio, Res fœti-

page.notes: The Syriac and some Hebrew vowel-pointed forms are reproduced from a small scan and may contain errors in diacritics; the Syriac plural forms in the first entries and the Syriac entries in "Syr. Fraenum" and "Syr. Copiosè" are doubtful. The letter פ standing alone is a section letter. The word "foeti-" continues on the next page.
